title: SessionStarted
description: Server -> client. Both peers receive this. The desktop is sent it first because it is the offerer, so it can begin the SDP offer immediately.

sessionId.description: Scopes every subsequent relayed message. Ephemeral -- it lives in the signaling server's memory only until ICE completes, and never in Postgres.

role.description: The recipient's own side of the session, not the peer's. `desktop` means "you are the offerer".
